empty.title: No feeds yet
empty.body: Add an RSS feed to start collecting anime updates automatically

loadFailed: Could not load the feed list. Please try again later.

automation.title: Subscription automation
automation.intro: Set release-group, quality, and language preferences for each anime. When a new item matches, notify only, ask for confirmation, or start the download automatically.

mode.title: Action after a match
mode.description: Filters decide which releases match. This setting decides what happens after a match.

NotifyOnly.title: Notify only
NotifyOnly.description: Mark the release as notify-only in the anime list without creating a download.

ManualConfirm.title: Confirm manually
ManualConfirm.description: Mark the release for confirmation in the anime list until you approve the download.

AutoDownload.title: Download automatically
AutoDownload.description: Submit the download immediately without another confirmation.

filters.title: Match filters
filters.description: Values within a field use OR; different fields must all pass. Leave a field empty to allow any value.

subtitleGroups.label: Subtitle / release groups
subtitleGroups.help: Match release-group names found in the title
subtitleGroups.placeholder: Type a group and press Enter

resolutions.label: Resolutions
resolutions.help: Allow one or more quality labels

codecs.label: Video codecs
codecs.help: Match HEVC, AVC, AV1, and similar labels

languages.label: Subtitle languages
languages.help: Match simplified Chinese, traditional Chinese, Japanese, and other labels

filters.sizeHelp: Size is evaluated from the byte count in the RSS item. Leave either side blank for no limit.
filters.sizeRangeError: Minimum size cannot be greater than maximum size.

excludedKeywords.label: Excluded keywords
excludedKeywords.help: A release is rejected if its title contains any of these words

upgrades.title: Version upgrades
upgrades.description: Automatically claim a higher-scoring release, validate every new file, then atomically switch mappings while keeping rollback data.
upgrades.enableHelp: Only upgrades that beat the active release by the threshold below are started.
upgrades.minimumScoreHelp: Required difference between the candidate and current release (1–1000).
upgrades.rollbackHoursHelp: Old files and mapping snapshots are retained for this period (1–720 hours).
upgrades.rangeError: Score improvement must be 1–1000 and rollback window must be 1–720 hours.

simulation.title: Simulate against history
simulation.description: Replay recent items with the current unsaved settings. This never sends notifications or creates downloads.
simulation.empty: Run a simulation to preview which historical releases match and why.
simulation.noHistory: This feed has no historical items to simulate yet.

reasons.anyValueAllowed: No restriction is set, so this passes
reasons.valueUnavailable: The release does not provide a value to evaluate
reasons.allowedValueMatched: At least one value is allowed
reasons.allowedValueMissed: No value is in the allowed set
reasons.withinSizeRange: The file size is within the allowed range
reasons.outsideSizeRange: The file size is outside the allowed range
reasons.noExcludedKeyword: The title contains no excluded keyword
reasons.excludedKeywordFound: The title contains an excluded keyword

actions.unsaved: No policy has been saved for this feed

automation.deleteConfirm: New releases will no longer be handled automatically. Remove this policy?

toast.loadFailed: Could not load the automation policy
toast.saveFailed: Failed to save the automation policy
toast.deleteFailed: Failed to remove the automation policy
toast.simulateFailed: Historical simulation failed. Please try again.

multiSource.title: Anime multi-source subscriptions
multiSource.description: Link existing feeds, order primary and fallback sources, and share quality rules, waiting limits, and download mode.
multiSource.precedence: Shared rules override linked feed rules. Original rules remain and resume after unlinking. Linking, unlinking, and deleting this subscription keep downloaded content. Uncertain episodes and batches require manual selection.
multiSource.name: Subscription name
multiSource.upgrade: Upgrade when a better version arrives
multiSource.waitExplanation: Waiting starts when an episode release is first collected; existing releases start at subscription creation. An eligible primary release is used immediately; fallbacks are ordered by priority after the deadline. Each episode has one active download decision. Once a fallback is downloaded, automatic upgrades keep that source; switching to a late primary requires manual selection.
multiSource.empty: No anime subscriptions yet. Add feeds, then link sources.
multiSource.unidentified: {{count}} releases have unconfirmed episodes; review manually
multiSource.error: Operation failed. Check that the show/season and feeds are not linked elsewhere, then retry.

reasons.waiting_for_primary: No eligible primary release; the waiting limit has not expired.
reasons.episode_already_downloading: This episode is already downloading; other sources are skipped.
reasons.existing_release_retained: Existing release retained without another download.
reasons.upgrade_threshold_not_met: The later release does not meet the upgrade threshold.
reasons.no_eligible_candidate: No candidate matches shared quality rules.
reasons.primary_available: The primary release matches the rules.
reasons.primary_wait_expired: The primary deadline expired; the highest-priority fallback was chosen.
reasons.submission_failed: Submission failed; evaluate again to retry.
reasons.download_queued: Better version submitted through the existing upgrade workflow.
reasons.upgrade_in_progress: A replacement is in progress; the current release remains playable.
reasons.mapping_pending: The release completed but its live file mappings are not ready; another download is held.
